description: Uploading a document to a meeting: pre-check, quota and persistence.
precondition: Meeting in a document-preparation status; file storage replaced by a recorder.

preconditions: Meeting "Họp HĐQT" planned 2026-12-15 (Vietnam time), Published; actor is Chair with no upload folder yet.
Storage has room; storage recorder accepts writes.
cases.inputs: files: one validated PDF "Bao-cao.pdf", 2 MB, 12 pages.
cases.return: Outcome with no failure and one document (name "Bao-cao.pdf", application/pdf, 2,097,152 bytes, 12 pages); endpoint answers MSG161.
cases.log: StoredFile row saved and object written under stored-files/<id>; library folder "Họp HĐQT – 15/12/2026" created for the Chair; Document and MeetingDocument rows committed in one transaction.

preconditions: Chair already has the meeting upload folder.
cases.inputs: files: two files both named "Phu-luc.pdf" with identical bytes.
cases.return: No failure; two documents are returned (same name or bytes is still two documents).
cases.log: Two StoredFile rows, two Document rows in the existing folder, two MeetingDocument rows.

preconditions: The Chair deleted the upload folder earlier.
cases.return: No failure; a new upload folder is created at the library root.
cases.log: New Folder row named "<title> – dd/MM/yyyy" with MeetingId set.

preconditions: Meeting Ended while the files were uploading (re-checked under the meeting lock).
cases.return: Failure Ended (HTTP 409, MSG172); no document is added.
cases.log: Written objects deleted and StoredFile rows stamped purged (released).

preconditions: Meeting Cancelled by the time of the lock.
Actor lost the Secretary role while uploading.
Meeting does not exist (deleted) at lock time.
Storage used is 100 MB; limit is 100 MB + 1 MB (stored files total).
cases.return: No failure; used plus new equals the limit exactly and is accepted.

preconditions: Storage used is 100 MB; limit is 100 MB + 1 MB - 1 byte.
cases.return: Failure StorageFull (HTTP 409, MSG346); nothing is stored.

preconditions: The database fails while the StoredFile rows are reserved.
cases.log: Error log "Failed to record uploaded files"

preconditions: Storage fails while writing the second of two objects.
cases.return: Failure StoreFailed (HTTP 503, MSG166); no document is added.
cases.log: First object deleted; both StoredFile rows stamped purged.

preconditions: The final commit fails with a database error after objects were written.
cases.log: Object deleted and StoredFile row stamped purged.

preconditions: The client abandons the request while objects are being written.
cases.inputs: files: one validated PDF; the cancellation token is cancelled.
cases.log: Written objects deleted; information log that the upload was abandoned.
